_why: Phase 2 gates the prize on openness: 'Only open datasets that are or will be made publicly available will be considered for a prize', and the dataset's terms must be defined. Two source records carried redistribution=unresolved, which is not a defensible state for a submission. Auditing them exposed a larger inconsistency of my own making: all ten EMA-sourced records have the standard reuse statement ABSENT from the text layer of the file we hold, yet they had been classified five different ways -- public_domain (3), CC_BY (1), publisher_restricted (5), unresolved (1). Identical provenance cannot carry five licences. These resolutions decide each case on verifiable grounds and always in the conservative direction. Nothing here relicenses a source: our CC BY 4.0 covers the curated compilation, its schema, documentation and code, and the `redistribution` column governs only whether the SOURCE FILE may be republished in the release bundle. The bundle ships a download manifest and a fetch script rather than third-party documents, so classifying a document cite-and-link costs the release nothing.

COG-S044.licence: NOT redistributable. Journal of Thrombosis and Haemostasis (Elsevier for the ISTH). Europe PMC REST core record read 2026-10-03 returns isOpenAccess=N, license=null and copyrightStatement=null while inPMC=Y and inEPMC=Y, i.e. free to read in PMC but outside the PMC Open Access subset; the NCBI OA service (oa.fcgi?id=PMC12766900) returns 404 for this record, confirming it is not in the OA set. Cite and link only. Our five measurements from this source are abstract-derived and are published as quoted values with attribution, not as republished text.

COG-S076.licence: EMA assessment report. The standard EMA statement ('Reproduction is authorised provided the source is acknowledged') is NOT present in the text layer of the file we hold, and EMA's own legal notice could not be read on 2026-10-03 (both https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/about-us/about-this-website/legal-notice and .../documents/other/legal-notice_en.pdf returned HTTP 404). No reuse permission is therefore asserted from any source we have actually read. Cite and link; do not republish the file.

COG-S091.licence: EMA assessment report (Kynamro). Previously `unresolved`. Resolved by decision, not by discovery: the statement is absent from the held text layer and EMA's legal notice was unreachable on 2026-10-03, so no reuse permission is asserted. Cite and link; do not republish the file.

Statement absent from the held text layer; EMA legal notice unreachable 2026-10-03. Cite and link; do not republish the file.
